description: SEC Form 4 insider transactions for one issuer ticker: an aggregate summary (transaction, buy and sell counts and values) plus the recent transaction rows, filed through 2026-10-22. The free precheck (GET /toll/insiders/precheck?op=ticker&ticker=...) returns the exact match count before paying. $0.005 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/insiders/ticker/{ticker}.

limit.description: Number of recent transactions to return
